files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+--add-modules=jdk.incubator.code
+--enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED
+-DHAT=SHOW_CODE,MINIMIZE_COPIES
+-cp '\
+   build/hat-optkl-1.0.jar:\
+   build/hat-core-1.0.jar:\
+   build/hat-backend-ffi-shared-1.0.jar:\
+   build/hat-backend-ffi-opencl-1.0.jar:\
+   build/hat-example-shared-1.0.jar:\
+   build/hat-example-shade-1.0.jar\
+'
+-Djava.library.path=./build
+shade.shaders.TruchetShader

@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+rm -rf \
+   build\
+   conf\
+   extractions/cmake-build-debug\
+   extractions/cuda/src\
+   extractions/opencl/src\
+   extractions/opengl/src
+
+rm -rf $(find . -type d -name target)

@@ -98,0 +98,3 @@
+          elif [[ -d ~/java/jextract-25/bin ]]; then
+             export JEXTRACT_HOME=$(realpath ~/java/jextract-25)
+             echo "We found jextract here ${JEXTRACT_HOME}"
